_comment: Copy this file to ntfy_config.json (untracked, see .gitignore) and fill in a real topic name. Used by scripts/notify_ntfy.py to page you when the scheduled audit flags something -- no email account needed. Install the ntfy app (App Store/Play Store) and subscribe to the same topic name to receive the notifications. IMPORTANT: pick a long, random, unguessable topic name -- ntfy.sh's public server has no authentication, so the topic name is the only thing keeping others from publishing to or reading your notifications. A good topic looks like 'eldara-a8f3k2p9x1' (random suffix), not 'eldara'.
